source_caption_text:
It’s lit and I’m out 😂🔥

Travis Scott performing “SICKO MODE” at ACL is one of those performances that takes you straight back to the ASTROWORLD era. The crowd knows every word, and when the beat switches, everyone goes crazy. You can see how much this song meant to people when it was everywhere.

Travis is feeding off the crowd the whole time, shouting his ad-libs while thousands of fans rap along with him. Every beat switch brings a different reaction, and the energy just keeps building as the song goes on.

“SICKO MODE” was already one of the biggest songs from ASTROWORLD, but watching a crowd this big go word for word with Travis hits different. If you were around when this song first came out, performances like this bring back memories of just how big that era really was.

#travisscott #live #meme
